hypothesis: For uneven wide-BF16 row distributions, only a subset of blocks may own a second row while all blocks still load full parameter caches. Requiring every block to own multiple rows may avoid cache overhead on one-row blocks. No runtime gain is assumed.

change.scope: BF16 wide-path parameter-cache enable gate only
change.behavior: Require minimumRowsPerBlock > 1 instead of maximumRowsPerBlock > 1 before attempting the full parameter-cache choices. A mixed one/two-row block distribution remains on the baseline streaming path.

static_reachability.condition: rowCount / blockCount == 1 and rowCount % blockCount > 0 on a wide row
static_reachability.before: maximumRowsPerBlock > 1 enabled full parameter-cache selection for every block
static_reachability.after: minimumRowsPerBlock == 1 disables full parameter-cache selection for every block
